audit: Removal of Official Artwork label, added sort by platform (ตามเครื่องเกม), and daily Today Pick feature

officialArtworkLabelRemoval.issue: Official Artwork black pill badge was rendered on the lower-left corner of game cards, obscuring the translator team plate.
resolution: Purged all 16 occurrences of 'Official Game Artwork' label in catalog.json.
Updated coverCandidates() in src/catalog-media.js to filter out any 'Official Game Artwork' string.
Repositioned .cover-origin to top: 8px; left: 8px with .hide rule in src/romthai-theme.css so it never overlaps the bottom-left translator plate.
Verified in Chrome: 0 visible cover-origin badges and translator plates are fully legible without obstruction.

sortByPlatform.feature: Added 'ตามเครื่องเกม' option to #sortSelect.
implementation: Added <option value="platform">ตามเครื่องเกม</option> to src/catalog-body.html.
Implemented platform sorting in filtered() in src/catalog-behavior.js using (a.platform||'').localeCompare(b.platform||'','en') || a.title.localeCompare(b.title,'th').
Verified in Chrome: games are cleanly grouped consecutively by console (3DS, GBA, NDS, PS1, etc.).

todayPick.feature: Today's Pick daily showcase of exactly 3 games, 3 different genres, and 3 different translation teams.
implementation: Added <section class="today-pick-section" id="todayPickSection"> to src/catalog-body.html with responsive 3-column grid.
Implemented deterministic daily seed (Asia/Bangkok YYYY-MM-DD) in renderTodayPick() in src/catalog-behavior.js ensuring exactly 3 games from 3 unique genres and 3 unique teams.
Added '🎲 สุ่มใหม่' button allowing users to re-roll a new trio on demand.
Verified in Chrome: exactly 3 games rendered with full interactive cards, distinct genres, distinct teams, and re-roll produces a new valid trio.
